---
title: "Protein feature annotation and property statistics for risk/nonrisk isoforms"
output: html_document
---

## Purpose

Resolving a CAD sQTL to a pair of full-length protein isoforms makes it possible to
ask what the risk-associated splice change does to the protein. This script
annotates every isoform of the unified pair table from script 02 with predicted
protein properties (length, amino-acid physicochemical indices, intrinsic disorder,
relative solvent accessibility and secondary structure, post-translational
modification sites, subcellular localization, Pfam domains, UniProt feature overlap
and AlphaFold3 metrics), computes the risk-minus-nonrisk difference of each property
for every pair, and assembles the differences into one wide property table per
analysis level, which script 06 profiles. The same properties are then compared
between CAD-associated and non-CAD VSMC sQTL junctions, because the manuscript asks
whether CAD-associated splice events preferentially affect particular protein
regions; the comparison is made on one representative isoform per junction, at the
whole-isoform level, at the junction position in genomic space (±30 bp) and in a
10-residue window around the junction in protein space, and once more with the
non-CAD set restricted to junctions sharing the risk allele's direction of effect.
Every statistical test is collected into `master_results_summary.csv`, which is
Supplementary Table 15. Finally, the predicted NMD status of each junction
(majority vote across the isoforms that contain it) and the named Pfam domains
gained or lost between the members of each pair are exported for Extended Data
Fig. 5 and the Results text.

## Manuscript outputs produced

- Supplementary Table 15 — all property comparisons (paired risk versus nonrisk at
  the isoform and junction level; CAD versus non-CAD at the isoform, junction,
  ±30 bp and ±10 aa levels; direction-matched and sub-property tests), with BH
  correction within each comparison family.
- Fig. 4f — junction overlap with UniProt protein features within 30 bp, CAD versus
  non-CAD coding junctions (n = 103 and 2,672; data table; the panel is drawn by
  `10_figure_and_table_generation.Rmd`).
- Fig. 4h, Extended Data Fig. 5d, Extended Data Fig. 7a and Supplementary Table 16 —
  the per-pair property tables that script 06 profiles.
- Extended Data Fig. 5b and Supplementary Table 13 — predicted NMD status per
  junction (majority vote), CAD versus non-CAD.
- Results, "CAD-associated splicing produces bidirectional domain loss" — named
  domain gains and losses per pair (domains differed within 43 of 94 pairs).
- Methods, "Protein feature annotation", "Overlap of sQTL junctions with protein
  features" and "Per-pair property profiling".

## Inputs

- `OUT_PAIRS_UNIFIED`, `OUT_PAIRS_UNIFIED_FLAGGED`, `OUT_JUNCTION_AA_MAPPING` — the
  unified pair table, its inclusion flags and the junction protein-space windows
  (script 02).
- `OUT_LFC_INTEGRATED` (script 01) and `F_GENERAL_SQTL_LR` — CAD and non-CAD VSMC
  sQTL junctions with their long-read isoforms.
- `F_SMC_GTF`, `F_SMC_INTRON_COORDS`, `F_SQANTI_PROTEIN_CPM`, `F_SMC_PROTEIN_FASTA` —
  long-read transcript models with CDS, junction–isoform map, SQANTI Protein table
  (CPM, NMD, ORF) and predicted protein sequences.
- `F_UNIPROT_ANNOT` — UniProt feature intervals (domains, secondary structure,
  disordered regions, topological domains) on hg38.
- `F_AAINDEX`, `F_IUPRED_SUMMARY`, `F_IUPRED_RESIDUES`, `F_NETSURFP_FEATURES`,
  `F_NETSURFP_RESIDUES`, `F_PTM_EXONS`, `F_PTM_SUMMARY`, `F_DEEPLOC_SMC`,
  `F_HMMSCAN_DOMTBLOUT` — per-isoform (and per-residue) property predictions from
  AAindex, IUPred3, NetSurfP-3.0, PTM-POSE, DeepLoc 2.0 and hmmscan/Pfam-A v35.0.
- `F_AF3_METRICS_ISO`, `F_AF3_METRICS_PAIR` — AlphaFold3 per-isoform and per-pair
  metrics produced by `python/compute_af3_metrics.py` from the AlphaFold3 models.

## Outputs (in `RES_03`)

- `property_table_isoform_wide.csv`, `property_table_junction_wide.csv` — per-pair
  risk, nonrisk and difference values for every property (script 06).
- `master_results_summary.csv` — all statistical comparisons (Supplementary
  Table 15; copied by script 10).
- `aggregate_cad_vs_noncad_junction_results.csv` — junction-level CAD versus non-CAD
  tests (Fig. 4f; script 10).
- `nmd_cad_junction_majority_vote.csv`, `nmd_noncad_junction_majority_vote.csv` —
  NMD majority vote per junction (Extended Data Fig. 5b, Supplementary Table 13;
  script 10).
- `junction_aa_mapping_NONCAD.csv` — protein-space windows of the non-CAD junctions.
- `domain_changes_named.csv`, `domain_changes_at_junction.csv` — Pfam domains gained
  or lost in the risk isoform, whole protein and within ±10 aa of the junction.
- Per-property value tables (`property_length_diff_unified.csv` … `property_junction_region_properties.csv`),
  `unified_property_stats.csv`, `direction_matched_*.csv` and the per-level
  `aggregate_cad_vs_noncad_*_results.csv` tables are intermediates of the above.

## Run order

Scripts 01 and 02, then `python/compute_af3_metrics.py`, must have been run.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source("config.R")
library(tidyverse)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(rtracklayer)
library(Biostrings)
library(data.table)

# Bind the dplyr verbs and the GenomicRanges reduce() explicitly, because the S4
# generics attached with GenomicRanges mask them.
reduce <- GenomicRanges::reduce
filter <- dplyr::filter
select <- dplyr::select
rename <- dplyr::rename
slice  <- dplyr::slice
count  <- dplyr::count

set.seed(42)
ensure_dir(RES_03)

require_files(OUT_PAIRS_UNIFIED, OUT_PAIRS_UNIFIED_FLAGGED, OUT_JUNCTION_AA_MAPPING,
              OUT_LFC_INTEGRATED, F_GENERAL_SQTL_LR,
              F_SMC_GTF, F_SMC_INTRON_COORDS, F_SQANTI_PROTEIN_CPM, F_SMC_PROTEIN_FASTA,
              F_UNIPROT_ANNOT, F_AAINDEX, F_IUPRED_SUMMARY, F_IUPRED_RESIDUES,
              F_NETSURFP_FEATURES, F_NETSURFP_RESIDUES, F_PTM_EXONS, F_PTM_SUMMARY,
              F_DEEPLOC_SMC, F_HMMSCAN_DOMTBLOUT, F_AF3_METRICS_ISO, F_AF3_METRICS_PAIR)

# Intermediate tables of this script.
res03 <- function(...) file.path(RES_03, ...)
OUT_UNIFIED_STATS   <- res03("unified_property_stats.csv")
OUT_DM_REPS_ALL     <- res03("direction_matched_isoforms_all.csv")
OUT_DM_REPS_CDS     <- res03("direction_matched_isoforms_cds.csv")
OUT_DM_RESULTS      <- res03("direction_matched_results.csv")
OUT_AGGREGATE_ISO   <- res03("aggregate_cad_vs_noncad_isoform_results.csv")
OUT_AGGREGATE_AA10  <- res03("aggregate_cad_vs_noncad_junction_aa10_results.csv")
OUT_AGGREGATE_SUB   <- res03("aggregate_cad_vs_noncad_subprop_results.csv")
OUT_AA10_TABLE      <- res03("junction_aa10_property_table.csv")
OUT_DOMAIN_CHANGES_LOCAL <- res03("domain_changes_at_junction.csv")

# Half-width (residues) of the protein window around each junction.
WINDOW_AA <- 10L
```

# 1. Shared resources

Everything the analyses below need is loaded once here: the CAD and non-CAD sQTL
junction sets, the long-read transcript models (CDS intervals per isoform and the
junction–isoform map), the SQANTI Protein table, the predicted proteins, the UniProt
feature intervals and the hmmscan Pfam table. The hmmscan `domtblout` is parsed once
because four analyses use it with different summaries.

```{r load_sqtl_and_models}
cad_sqtls <- read_tsv(OUT_LFC_INTEGRATED, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(junction_key = paste(chr, intron_start, intron_end, sep = ":"))
cad_junction_keys_all <- cad_sqtls %>%
  distinct(chr, intron_start, intron_end, strand) %>%
  mutate(junction_key = paste(chr, intron_start, intron_end, sep = ":")) %>%
  pull(junction_key) %>% unique()

general_sqtls <- read_tsv(F_GENERAL_SQTL_LR, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(junction_key = paste(chr, intron_start, intron_end, sep = ":")) %>%
  filter(!cluster_id %in% unique(cad_sqtls$cluster))
general_junction_keys_all <- general_sqtls %>%
  distinct(chr, intron_start, intron_end, junction_id, junction_key) %>%
  pull(junction_key) %>% unique()

# CDS intervals per long-read transcript.
smc_gtf_df <- as.data.frame(rtracklayer::import(F_SMC_GTF))
cds_by_transcript <- smc_gtf_df %>%
  filter(type == "CDS") %>%
  mutate(pb_id = str_extract(transcript_id, "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pb_id)) %>%
  makeGRangesFromDataFrame(seqnames.field = "seqnames", start.field = "start",
                           end.field = "end", strand.field = "strand",
                           keep.extra.columns = TRUE)
seqlevelsStyle(cds_by_transcript) <- "UCSC"
cds_lookup <- split(cds_by_transcript, cds_by_transcript$pb_id)
rm(smc_gtf_df); invisible(gc(verbose = FALSE))

sqanti_protein <- read_csv(F_SQANTI_PROTEIN_CPM, show_col_types = FALSE)
colnames(sqanti_protein)[colnames(sqanti_protein) == "pb"] <- "pb_acc"

smc_junc_isoform <- read_tsv(F_SMC_INTRON_COORDS, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(junction_key = paste(chr, intron_start, intron_end, sep = ":"),
         pb_id = str_extract(trans_id, "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pb_id))

# Predicted proteins: `protein_lookup` strips the terminal stop; `prot_seqs_full`
# keeps the raw record and its width for the whole-isoform length comparison.
smc_fasta <- readAAStringSet(F_SMC_PROTEIN_FASTA)
fasta_pbs <- str_extract(names(smc_fasta), "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+")
protein_lookup <- tibble(pb_acc = fasta_pbs, protein_seq = as.character(smc_fasta)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pb_acc)) %>%
  mutate(protein_seq = str_remove(protein_seq, "\\*$")) %>%
  distinct(pb_acc, .keep_all = TRUE)
prot_seqs_full <- tibble(pb_acc = fasta_pbs, sequence = as.character(smc_fasta),
                         aa_length = width(smc_fasta)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pb_acc)) %>%
  distinct(pb_acc, .keep_all = TRUE)
rm(smc_fasta); invisible(gc(verbose = FALSE))

uniprot <- read_tsv(F_UNIPROT_ANNOT, show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r helpers}
# ---- hmmscan domtblout -------------------------------------------------------
# Space-delimited with a free-text description from field 23; fields 18-19 are the
# alignment coordinates in the query protein.
hmm_lines <- read_lines(F_HMMSCAN_DOMTBLOUT)
hmm_lines <- hmm_lines[!str_starts(hmm_lines, "#") & nchar(hmm_lines) > 0]
hmm_df <- bind_rows(lapply(hmm_lines, function(line) {
  parts <- strsplit(line, "\\s+")[[1]]
  parts <- parts[parts != ""]
  if (length(parts) < 19) return(NULL)
  data.frame(domain_name = parts[1], domain_acc = parts[2], query_name = parts[4],
             seq_from = as.integer(parts[18]), seq_to = as.integer(parts[19]),
             description = if (length(parts) >= 23) paste(parts[23:length(parts)], collapse = " ") else "",
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
})) %>%
  mutate(pb_id = str_extract(query_name, "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+"),
         domain_acc_clean = sub("\\..*", "", domain_acc)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pb_id))
rm(hmm_lines)

# ---- AAindex ---------------------------------------------------------------------
aa_idx <- read_csv(F_AAINDEX, show_col_types = FALSE)
make_aa_vec <- function(col) setNames(aa_idx[[col]], aa_idx$aa)
aa_vecs <- list(hydropathy = make_aa_vec("hydropathy"), polarity = make_aa_vec("polarity"),
                volume = make_aa_vec("volume"), flexibility = make_aa_vec("flexibility"))
# Mean of a per-residue index over a sequence (residues absent from the index are skipped).
aa_mean_for_seq <- function(seq_str, vec) {
  if (is.na(seq_str) || nchar(seq_str) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  aas <- strsplit(seq_str, "")[[1]]
  aas <- aas[aas %in% names(vec)]
  if (length(aas) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  mean(vec[aas])
}

# ---- Genomic helpers -------------------------------------------------------------
# UniProt feature intervals (0-based BED starts) as reduced GRanges.
build_uniprot_gr <- function(uniprot_df, category_filter, name_filter = NULL) {
  df <- uniprot_df %>% filter(category %in% category_filter)
  if (!is.null(name_filter)) df <- df %>% filter(name == name_filter)
  df <- df %>% mutate(start_1based = chromStart + 1, end_1based = chromEnd)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(GRanges())
  gr <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(df, seqnames.field = "chrom", start.field = "start_1based",
                                 end.field = "end_1based", keep.extra.columns = TRUE)
  seqlevelsStyle(gr) <- "UCSC"
  GenomicRanges::reduce(gr)
}
# "chr:start:end" keys to GRanges.
jk_to_gr <- function(jks) {
  parts <- str_split(jks, ":", simplify = TRUE)
  gr <- GRanges(parts[, 1], IRanges(as.integer(parts[, 2]), as.integer(parts[, 3])))
  seqlevelsStyle(gr) <- "UCSC"
  gr
}
# Does the junction overlap the CDS of the given isoform?
junc_in_cds <- function(jk, pb) {
  if (is.na(pb) || !pb %in% names(cds_lookup)) return(NA)
  length(findOverlaps(cds_lookup[[pb]], jk_to_gr(jk))) > 0
}

# ---- Group tests (CAD versus non-CAD) --------------------------------------------
test_continuous <- function(data, value_col, property_label, level_label, direction_val = NULL) {
  d <- data %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[value_col]]))
  if (!is.null(direction_val)) d <- d %>% filter(direction == direction_val)
  cad_v <- d %>% filter(group == "CAD")    %>% pull(value_col)
  non_v <- d %>% filter(group == "nonCAD") %>% pull(value_col)
  if (length(cad_v) < 3 || length(non_v) < 3) return(NULL)
  wt <- tryCatch(wilcox.test(cad_v, non_v), error = function(e) NULL)
  p_val <- if (!is.null(wt)) wt$p.value else NA_real_
  out <- tibble(property = value_col, property_label = property_label, level = level_label)
  if (!is.null(direction_val)) out$direction <- direction_val
  bind_cols(out, tibble(n_cad = length(cad_v), n_noncad = length(non_v),
                        median_cad = median(cad_v), median_noncad = median(non_v),
                        test = "Wilcoxon rank-sum",
                        statistic = if (!is.null(wt)) unname(wt$statistic) else NA_real_,
                        p_value = p_val, sig = sig_label(p_val)))
}
test_binary <- function(data, value_col, property_label, level_label, direction_val = NULL) {
  d <- data %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[value_col]]))
  if (!is.null(direction_val)) d <- d %>% filter(direction == direction_val)
  if (nrow(d) < 5) return(NULL)
  tab <- table(d$group, d[[value_col]])
  if (any(dim(tab) < 2)) return(NULL)
  ft <- tryCatch(fisher.test(tab), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(ft)) return(NULL)
  cad_yes <- sum(d$group == "CAD"    & as.logical(d[[value_col]]))
  cad_tot <- sum(d$group == "CAD")
  non_yes <- sum(d$group == "nonCAD" & as.logical(d[[value_col]]))
  non_tot <- sum(d$group == "nonCAD")
  out <- tibble(property = value_col, property_label = property_label, level = level_label)
  if (!is.null(direction_val)) out$direction <- direction_val
  bind_cols(out, tibble(n_cad = cad_tot, n_noncad = non_tot,
                        pct_cad = round(100 * cad_yes / cad_tot, 1),
                        pct_noncad = round(100 * non_yes / non_tot, 1),
                        test = "Fisher's exact", statistic = round(unname(ft$estimate), 2),
                        p_value = ft$p.value, sig = sig_label(ft$p.value)))
}

# ---- Supplementary Table 15 -----------------------------------------------------
# Rows of one comparison class replace any earlier rows of the same class, so the
# table is rebuilt deterministically from the start of this script.
MASTER_COLS <- c("comparison", "analysis", "metric", "group1", "group1_value", "group1_n",
                 "group1_total", "group2", "group2_value", "group2_n", "group2_total",
                 "test", "statistic", "p_value", "p_adj", "sig")
append_master <- function(master_new, class_regex) {
  master_new <- master_new %>% select(all_of(MASTER_COLS))
  if (file.exists(OUT_PROPERTY_STATS_MASTER)) {
    master_existing <- read_csv(OUT_PROPERTY_STATS_MASTER, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      filter(!str_detect(comparison, class_regex))
    master_new <- bind_rows(master_existing, master_new)
  }
  write_csv(master_new, OUT_PROPERTY_STATS_MASTER)
  invisible(master_new)
}
```

# 2. The pair analysis set

Salvaged pairs are kept only when the CAD junction overlaps the CDS of the anchor
isoform, because the property comparison is meaningful only when the splice change
lies within the protein; strict and AP-MS pairs are kept as they are. The inclusion
flags from script 02 decide which pairs enter the junction-level (strict pairs) and
isoform-level (strict, salvaged and non-redundant AP-MS pairs) statistics.

```{r pair_analysis_set}
unified_pairs <- read_csv(OUT_PAIRS_UNIFIED, show_col_types = FALSE)
flags_full    <- read_csv(OUT_PAIRS_UNIFIED_FLAGGED, show_col_types = FALSE)
flags <- flags_full %>%
  select(gene_name, risk_pb, nonrisk_pb, include_in_isoform_stats, include_in_junction_stats)

salvaged_only <- unified_pairs %>%
  filter(pair_type == "salvaged") %>%
  mutate(anchor_pb = ifelse(salvage_side == "risk", nonrisk_pb, risk_pb))
salvaged_only$junction_in_anchor_cds <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(salvaged_only)), function(i) {
  junc_in_cds(salvaged_only$cad_sqtl_junction[i], salvaged_only$anchor_pb[i])
}, logical(1))
salvaged_valid <- salvaged_only %>%
  filter(isTRUE(junction_in_anchor_cds) | junction_in_anchor_cds == TRUE)

unified_for_analysis <- bind_rows(
  unified_pairs %>% filter(pair_type == "strict"),
  salvaged_valid %>% select(-anchor_pb, -junction_in_anchor_cds),
  unified_pairs %>% filter(pair_type == "manual_apms")
)
print(unified_for_analysis %>% count(pair_type))

# Accumulator for the long property table (one entry per property).
unified_property_results <- list()
stash_property <- function(df, prop_name, risk_col, nonrisk_col, delta_col) {
  unified_property_results[[prop_name]] <<- df %>%
    transmute(gene_name, cad_sqtl_junction, pair_type, risk_pb, nonrisk_pb,
              risk_value = .data[[risk_col]], nonrisk_value = .data[[nonrisk_col]],
              delta = .data[[delta_col]], property = prop_name)
}
```

# 3. UniProt feature intervals

UniProt domain, secondary-structure, disordered-region and topological-domain
annotations of the canonical protein, projected onto hg38, are converted to reduced
genomic intervals once; they serve the paired CDS-overlap comparison (section 11) and
the junction-anchored CAD versus non-CAD tests (sections 16 and 17).

```{r annotation_granges}
domain_gr      <- build_uniprot_gr(uniprot, "domain")
disordered_gr  <- build_uniprot_gr(uniprot, "region of interest", "Disordered")
secondary_gr   <- build_uniprot_gr(uniprot, c("beta strand", "turn", "helix", "coiled-coil region"))
topological_gr <- build_uniprot_gr(uniprot, "topological domain")
```

# 4. Protein length

```{r prop_length}
prot_lookup <- protein_lookup %>% mutate(aa_len = nchar(protein_seq)) %>% select(pb_acc, aa_len)

length_table <- unified_for_analysis %>%
  left_join(prot_lookup %>% dplyr::rename(risk_aa_len    = aa_len), by = c("risk_pb" = "pb_acc")) %>%
  left_join(prot_lookup %>% dplyr::rename(nonrisk_aa_len = aa_len), by = c("nonrisk_pb" = "pb_acc")) %>%
  mutate(delta_aa_len = risk_aa_len - nonrisk_aa_len,
         abs_delta = abs(delta_aa_len),
         direction = case_when(delta_aa_len > 0 ~ "risk_longer", delta_aa_len < 0 ~ "risk_shorter",
                               delta_aa_len == 0 ~ "equal", TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  select(gene_name, cad_sqtl_junction, pair_type, risk_pb, nonrisk_pb,
         risk_aa_len, nonrisk_aa_len, delta_aa_len, abs_delta, direction,
         salvage_side, salvage_pct_identity)

write_csv(length_table, res03("property_length_diff_unified.csv"))
stash_property(length_table, "aa_length", "risk_aa_len", "nonrisk_aa_len", "delta_aa_len")
```

# 5. AAindex amino-acid properties

Mean Kyte–Doolittle hydropathy, Zimmerman polarity, Grantham volume and flexibility
per isoform, from the AAindex scales.

```{r prop_aaindex}
needed_pbs <- unique(c(unified_for_analysis$risk_pb, unified_for_analysis$nonrisk_pb))
aa_props <- protein_lookup %>%
  filter(pb_acc %in% needed_pbs) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(mean_hydropathy  = aa_mean_for_seq(protein_seq, aa_vecs$hydropathy),
         mean_polarity    = aa_mean_for_seq(protein_seq, aa_vecs$polarity),
         mean_volume      = aa_mean_for_seq(protein_seq, aa_vecs$volume),
         mean_flexibility = aa_mean_for_seq(protein_seq, aa_vecs$flexibility)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(pb_acc, mean_hydropathy, mean_polarity, mean_volume, mean_flexibility)

aa_table <- unified_for_analysis %>%
  left_join(aa_props %>% dplyr::rename(risk_hydropathy = mean_hydropathy, risk_polarity = mean_polarity,
                                       risk_volume = mean_volume, risk_flexibility = mean_flexibility),
            by = c("risk_pb" = "pb_acc")) %>%
  left_join(aa_props %>% dplyr::rename(nonrisk_hydropathy = mean_hydropathy, nonrisk_polarity = mean_polarity,
                                       nonrisk_volume = mean_volume, nonrisk_flexibility = mean_flexibility),
            by = c("nonrisk_pb" = "pb_acc")) %>%
  mutate(delta_hydropathy  = risk_hydropathy  - nonrisk_hydropathy,
         delta_polarity    = risk_polarity    - nonrisk_polarity,
         delta_volume      = risk_volume      - nonrisk_volume,
         delta_flexibility = risk_flexibility - nonrisk_flexibility)

out_cols <- c("gene_name", "cad_sqtl_junction", "pair_type", "risk_pb", "nonrisk_pb",
              "risk_hydropathy", "nonrisk_hydropathy", "delta_hydropathy",
              "risk_polarity", "nonrisk_polarity", "delta_polarity",
              "risk_volume", "nonrisk_volume", "delta_volume",
              "risk_flexibility", "nonrisk_flexibility", "delta_flexibility")
write_csv(aa_table %>% select(any_of(out_cols)), res03("property_aaindex_unified.csv"))
for (m in c("hydropathy", "polarity", "volume", "flexibility")) {
  stash_property(aa_table, m, paste0("risk_", m), paste0("nonrisk_", m), paste0("delta_", m))
}
```

# 6. Intrinsic disorder (IUPred3)

```{r prop_idr}
idr_data <- read_csv(F_IUPRED_SUMMARY, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(pb_acc = str_extract(sequence_id, "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pb_acc)) %>%
  select(pb_acc, percent_idr) %>%
  distinct(pb_acc, .keep_all = TRUE)

idr_table <- unified_for_analysis %>%
  left_join(idr_data %>% dplyr::rename(risk_idr    = percent_idr), by = c("risk_pb" = "pb_acc")) %>%
  left_join(idr_data %>% dplyr::rename(nonrisk_idr = percent_idr), by = c("nonrisk_pb" = "pb_acc")) %>%
  mutate(delta_idr = risk_idr - nonrisk_idr)

write_csv(idr_table, res03("property_idr_unified.csv"))
stash_property(idr_table, "idr_percent", "risk_idr", "nonrisk_idr", "delta_idr")
```

# 7. NetSurfP-3.0 structure

Per-isoform secondary-structure fractions, mean relative solvent accessibility (RSA)
and mean disorder. The helix/strand fractions are carried in the tables but the
manuscript uses RSA as the structural metric.

```{r prop_netsurfp}
nsp <- read_csv(F_NETSURFP_FEATURES, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(pb_acc = str_extract(protein_id, "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pb_acc))
nsp_cols <- intersect(c("pct_helix", "pct_sheet", "pct_coil", "mean_rsa", "mean_disorder"), names(nsp))
nsp_subset <- nsp %>% select(pb_acc, all_of(nsp_cols)) %>% distinct(pb_acc, .keep_all = TRUE)

nsp_table <- unified_for_analysis %>%
  left_join(nsp_subset %>% rename_with(~ paste0("risk_", .x), all_of(nsp_cols)),
            by = c("risk_pb" = "pb_acc")) %>%
  left_join(nsp_subset %>% rename_with(~ paste0("nonrisk_", .x), all_of(nsp_cols)),
            by = c("nonrisk_pb" = "pb_acc"))
for (col in nsp_cols) {
  nsp_table[[paste0("delta_", col)]] <- nsp_table[[paste0("risk_", col)]] - nsp_table[[paste0("nonrisk_", col)]]
}

write_csv(nsp_table, res03("property_netsurfp_unified.csv"))
for (col in nsp_cols) {
  stash_property(nsp_table, paste0("nsp_", col), paste0("risk_", col), paste0("nonrisk_", col),
                 paste0("delta_", col))
}
```

# 8. Post-translational modification content (PTM-POSE)

PhosphoSitePlus sites projected onto each isoform; the per-isoform summary counts
PTMs and the fraction of exons carrying at least one PTM.

```{r prop_ptm}
ptm_exons <- fread(F_PTM_EXONS) %>% as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(pb_acc  = str_extract(event_id, "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+"),
         has_ptm = `Number of PTMs Affected` > 0) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pb_acc))
ptm_per_isoform <- ptm_exons %>%
  group_by(pb_acc) %>%
  summarise(total_ptm_exons = sum(has_ptm), total_exons = n(),
            total_ptms = sum(`Number of PTMs Affected`),
            pct_exons_with_ptm = total_ptm_exons / total_exons * 100, .groups = "drop")
ptm_metrics <- c("total_ptms", "pct_exons_with_ptm")

ptm_table <- unified_for_analysis %>%
  left_join(ptm_per_isoform %>% select(pb_acc, all_of(ptm_metrics)) %>%
              rename_with(~ paste0("risk_", .x), all_of(ptm_metrics)), by = c("risk_pb" = "pb_acc")) %>%
  left_join(ptm_per_isoform %>% select(pb_acc, all_of(ptm_metrics)) %>%
              rename_with(~ paste0("nonrisk_", .x), all_of(ptm_metrics)), by = c("nonrisk_pb" = "pb_acc"))
for (m in ptm_metrics) {
  ptm_table[[paste0("delta_", m)]] <- ptm_table[[paste0("risk_", m)]] - ptm_table[[paste0("nonrisk_", m)]]
}

write_csv(ptm_table, res03("property_ptm_unified.csv"))
for (m in ptm_metrics) {
  stash_property(ptm_table, paste0("ptm_", m), paste0("risk_", m), paste0("nonrisk_", m), paste0("delta_", m))
}
```

# 9. Subcellular localization (DeepLoc 2.0)

Compartment probabilities enter the property table as continuous values; the
categorical calls (localization, signal peptides, membrane type) are carried for the
concordance checks of script 06.

```{r prop_deeploc}
deeploc <- read_csv(F_DEEPLOC_SMC, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(pb_acc = str_extract(Protein_ID, "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pb_acc)) %>%
  distinct(pb_acc, .keep_all = TRUE)
dl_cat_cols  <- intersect(c("Localizations", "Signals", "Membrane types"), names(deeploc))
dl_prob_cols <- intersect(c("Cytoplasm", "Nucleus", "Extracellular", "Cell membrane", "Mitochondrion",
                            "Endoplasmic reticulum", "Golgi apparatus", "Lysosome/Vacuole", "Peroxisome"),
                          names(deeploc))
deeploc_select <- deeploc %>% select(pb_acc, all_of(c(dl_cat_cols, dl_prob_cols)))

dl_table <- unified_for_analysis %>%
  left_join(deeploc_select %>% rename_with(~ paste0("risk_", .x), all_of(c(dl_cat_cols, dl_prob_cols))),
            by = c("risk_pb" = "pb_acc")) %>%
  left_join(deeploc_select %>% rename_with(~ paste0("nonrisk_", .x), all_of(c(dl_cat_cols, dl_prob_cols))),
            by = c("nonrisk_pb" = "pb_acc"))
for (cc in dl_cat_cols) {
  dl_table[[paste0(cc, "_same")]] <- dl_table[[paste0("risk_", cc)]] == dl_table[[paste0("nonrisk_", cc)]]
}
for (pc in dl_prob_cols) {
  dl_table[[paste0("delta_", pc)]] <- dl_table[[paste0("risk_", pc)]] - dl_table[[paste0("nonrisk_", pc)]]
}

write_csv(dl_table, res03("property_deeploc_unified.csv"))
for (pc in dl_prob_cols) {
  stash_property(dl_table, paste0("deeploc_", gsub("[/ ]", "_", tolower(pc))),
                 paste0("risk_", pc), paste0("nonrisk_", pc), paste0("delta_", pc))
}
```

# 10. Pfam domains (hmmscan)

```{r prop_pfam}
domain_per_isoform <- hmm_df %>%
  group_by(pb_acc = pb_id) %>%
  summarise(n_domains = n(), n_unique_domains = n_distinct(domain_acc_clean),
            domain_names = paste(unique(domain_name), collapse = ";"), .groups = "drop")

# Isoforms without any hit have zero domains.
all_pair_pbs <- unique(c(unified_for_analysis$risk_pb, unified_for_analysis$nonrisk_pb))
all_pair_pbs <- all_pair_pbs[!is.na(all_pair_pbs)]
domain_full <- tibble(pb_acc = all_pair_pbs) %>%
  left_join(domain_per_isoform, by = "pb_acc") %>%
  mutate(n_domains = replace_na(n_domains, 0), n_unique_domains = replace_na(n_unique_domains, 0),
         has_domain = n_domains > 0)
pfam_metrics <- c("n_domains", "n_unique_domains")

pfam_table <- unified_for_analysis %>%
  left_join(domain_full %>% select(pb_acc, all_of(pfam_metrics)) %>%
              rename_with(~ paste0("risk_", .x), all_of(pfam_metrics)), by = c("risk_pb" = "pb_acc")) %>%
  left_join(domain_full %>% select(pb_acc, all_of(pfam_metrics)) %>%
              rename_with(~ paste0("nonrisk_", .x), all_of(pfam_metrics)), by = c("nonrisk_pb" = "pb_acc"))
for (m in pfam_metrics) {
  pfam_table[[paste0("delta_", m)]] <- pfam_table[[paste0("risk_", m)]] - pfam_table[[paste0("nonrisk_", m)]]
}

write_csv(pfam_table, res03("property_pfam_unified.csv"))
for (m in pfam_metrics) {
  stash_property(pfam_table, paste0("pfam_", m), paste0("risk_", m), paste0("nonrisk_", m), paste0("delta_", m))
}
```

# 11. Overlap of the coding sequence with UniProt features

For each isoform the fraction of its CDS (in genomic coordinates) that overlaps
UniProt domains, disordered regions and secondary-structure elements is computed;
the paired comparison at the junction level asks whether risk isoforms lose or gain
annotated regions relative to their nonrisk partners.

```{r prop_annotation_overlap}
get_overlap_prop <- function(pb, ann_gr) {
  cds <- cds_lookup[[pb]]
  if (is.null(cds) || length(cds) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  total_bp <- sum(width(cds))
  if (total_bp == 0) return(NA_real_)
  sum(width(GenomicRanges::intersect(cds, ann_gr, ignore.strand = TRUE))) / total_bp
}
calc_pair_overlap <- function(risk_pb, nonrisk_pb, ann_gr) {
  tibble(risk_overlap = get_overlap_prop(risk_pb, ann_gr), nonrisk_overlap = get_overlap_prop(nonrisk_pb, ann_gr))
}

annot_specs <- list(list(gr = domain_gr,     name = "domain"),
                    list(gr = disordered_gr, name = "disordered"),
                    list(gr = secondary_gr,  name = "secondary"))
for (a in annot_specs) {
  pair_results <- unified_for_analysis %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(o = list(calc_pair_overlap(risk_pb, nonrisk_pb, a$gr))) %>%
    unnest(o) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(delta_overlap = risk_overlap - nonrisk_overlap, annotation = a$name,
           risk_has = risk_overlap > 0, nonrisk_has = nonrisk_overlap > 0,
           change = case_when(risk_has & !nonrisk_has ~ "Gained in Risk",
                              !risk_has & nonrisk_has ~ "Lost in Risk",
                              risk_has & nonrisk_has  ~ "Both Overlap",
                              TRUE ~ "Neither"))
  write_csv(pair_results, res03(sprintf("property_%s_unified.csv", a$name)))
  stash_property(pair_results, paste0("annot_overlap_", a$name), "risk_overlap", "nonrisk_overlap", "delta_overlap")
}
```

# 12. AlphaFold3 metrics

Whole-isoform metrics (confidence, radius of gyration, surface charge, disorder and
secondary-structure fractions, PTM exposure) are joined per side; pair-level metrics
(TM-score, alignment identity and gap statistics between the two models) have no
per-side value and enter as the pair value only; junction-region metrics are the
same quantities restricted to the residues around the junction.

```{r prop_af3}
af3     <- read_csv(F_AF3_METRICS_PAIR, show_col_types = FALSE)
af3_iso <- read_csv(F_AF3_METRICS_ISO,  show_col_types = FALSE)

af3_base <- af3 %>% select(gene_name, cad_sqtl_junction = junction, pair_type, risk_pb, nonrisk_pb)
af3_iso_metrics  <- c("mean_plddt", "radius_of_gyration", "surface_charge", "idr_fraction_pct",
                      "pct_helix", "pct_sheet", "pct_loop", "ptm_pct_exposed", "ptm", "iptm", "mean_pae")
af3_pair_metrics <- c("tm_score", "pct_identity", "aligned_length", "n_gap_openings",
                      "total_gap_length", "query_coverage_pct", "length_ratio")
af3_junc_metrics <- c("pct_helix", "pct_sheet", "surface_charge", "idr_pct", "mean_plddt")

for (m in af3_iso_metrics) {
  if (!m %in% names(af3_iso)) next
  iso_lookup <- af3_iso %>% select(pb_acc, !!m)
  unified_property_results[[paste0("af3_iso_", m)]] <- af3_base %>%
    left_join(iso_lookup %>% dplyr::rename(risk_value    = !!m), by = c("risk_pb"    = "pb_acc")) %>%
    left_join(iso_lookup %>% dplyr::rename(nonrisk_value = !!m), by = c("nonrisk_pb" = "pb_acc")) %>%
    mutate(delta = risk_value - nonrisk_value, property = paste0("af3_iso_", m))
}
for (m in af3_pair_metrics) {
  if (!m %in% names(af3)) next
  unified_property_results[[paste0("af3_pair_", m)]] <- af3 %>%
    transmute(gene_name, cad_sqtl_junction = junction, pair_type, risk_pb, nonrisk_pb,
              risk_value = NA_real_, nonrisk_value = NA_real_, delta = .data[[m]],
              property = paste0("af3_pair_", m))
}
for (m in af3_junc_metrics) {
  risk_col <- paste0("junc_risk_junc_", m); nonrisk_col <- paste0("junc_nonrisk_junc_", m)
  if (!risk_col %in% names(af3) || !nonrisk_col %in% names(af3)) next
  unified_property_results[[paste0("af3_junc_", m)]] <- af3 %>%
    transmute(gene_name, cad_sqtl_junction = junction, pair_type, risk_pb, nonrisk_pb,
              risk_value = .data[[risk_col]], nonrisk_value = .data[[nonrisk_col]],
              delta = .data[[risk_col]] - .data[[nonrisk_col]], property = paste0("af3_junc_", m))
}
```

# 13. Properties of the junction region (±10 residues)

Using the protein-space windows from script 02, each sequence-based property is
recomputed for the 20-residue window around the junction on both isoforms of a pair.
The window summaries use their own per-residue vectors (Kyte–Doolittle hydropathy,
residue mass and side-chain charge), per-residue IUPred and NetSurfP-3 predictions,
PTM-POSE site positions and Pfam domain coordinates.

```{r prop_junction_region}
aa_map <- read_csv(OUT_JUNCTION_AA_MAPPING, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(str_starts(status, "ok")) %>%
  select(pb_acc, junction_key, aa_window_start, aa_window_end)

get_window <- function(pb, jk) {
  if (is.na(pb) || is.na(jk) || jk == "manual_apms") return(c(NA_integer_, NA_integer_))
  hit <- aa_map %>% filter(pb_acc == pb, junction_key == jk)
  if (nrow(hit) == 0) return(c(NA_integer_, NA_integer_))
  c(hit$aa_window_start[1], hit$aa_window_end[1])
}

windows <- unified_for_analysis %>%
  mutate(risk_window    = map2(risk_pb,    cad_sqtl_junction, get_window),
         nonrisk_window = map2(nonrisk_pb, cad_sqtl_junction, get_window),
         risk_ws    = map_int(risk_window,    ~ as.integer(.x[1])),
         risk_we    = map_int(risk_window,    ~ as.integer(.x[2])),
         nonrisk_ws = map_int(nonrisk_window, ~ as.integer(.x[1])),
         nonrisk_we = map_int(nonrisk_window, ~ as.integer(.x[2]))) %>%
  select(-risk_window, -nonrisk_window)

stash_window <- function(prop_name, risk_vec, nonrisk_vec) {
  unified_property_results[[prop_name]] <<- tibble(
    gene_name = windows$gene_name, cad_sqtl_junction = windows$cad_sqtl_junction,
    pair_type = windows$pair_type, risk_pb = windows$risk_pb, nonrisk_pb = windows$nonrisk_pb,
    risk_value = risk_vec, nonrisk_value = nonrisk_vec, delta = risk_vec - nonrisk_vec,
    property = prop_name)
}

# Per-residue vectors for the window summaries: Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy, residue
# molecular weight (Da) and side-chain charge at neutral pH (His = +0.5).
aa_hydro <- c(A=1.8, R=-4.5, N=-3.5, D=-3.5, C=2.5, Q=-3.5, E=-3.5, G=-0.4, H=-3.2, I=4.5, L=3.8,
              K=-3.9, M=1.9, F=2.8, P=-1.6, S=-0.8, T=-0.7, W=-0.9, Y=-1.3, V=4.2, U=2.5, X=0)
aa_mw <- c(A=89.1, R=174.2, N=132.1, D=133.1, C=121.2, Q=146.2, E=147.1, G=75.0, H=155.2, I=131.2,
           L=131.2, K=146.2, M=149.2, F=165.2, P=115.1, S=105.1, T=119.1, W=204.2, Y=181.2, V=117.2,
           U=121.2, X=128.2)
aa_charge <- c(A=0, R=1, N=0, D=-1, C=0, Q=0, E=-1, G=0, H=0.5, I=0, L=0, K=1, M=0, F=0, P=0, S=0,
               T=0, W=0, Y=0, V=0, U=0, X=0)

prot_seq_lookup <- protein_lookup %>% select(pb_acc, protein_seq) %>% deframe()
extract_window_seq <- function(pb, ws, we) {
  if (is.na(pb) || is.na(ws) || is.na(we)) return(NA_character_)
  full <- prot_seq_lookup[[pb]]
  if (is.null(full) || is.na(full)) return(NA_character_)
  ws <- max(1, ws); we <- min(nchar(full), we)
  if (we < ws) return(NA_character_)
  substr(full, ws, we)
}

windows <- windows %>%
  mutate(risk_seq    = pmap_chr(list(risk_pb,    risk_ws,    risk_we),    extract_window_seq),
         nonrisk_seq = pmap_chr(list(nonrisk_pb, nonrisk_ws, nonrisk_we), extract_window_seq),
         risk_aa_hydro     = map_dbl(risk_seq,    ~ aa_mean_for_seq(.x, aa_hydro)),
         nonrisk_aa_hydro  = map_dbl(nonrisk_seq, ~ aa_mean_for_seq(.x, aa_hydro)),
         risk_aa_mw        = map_dbl(risk_seq,    ~ aa_mean_for_seq(.x, aa_mw)),
         nonrisk_aa_mw     = map_dbl(nonrisk_seq, ~ aa_mean_for_seq(.x, aa_mw)),
         risk_aa_charge    = map_dbl(risk_seq,    ~ aa_mean_for_seq(.x, aa_charge)),
         nonrisk_aa_charge = map_dbl(nonrisk_seq, ~ aa_mean_for_seq(.x, aa_charge)))
stash_window("aa_junc_hydro",  windows$risk_aa_hydro,  windows$nonrisk_aa_hydro)
stash_window("aa_junc_mw",     windows$risk_aa_mw,     windows$nonrisk_aa_mw)
stash_window("aa_junc_charge", windows$risk_aa_charge, windows$nonrisk_aa_charge)

# IUPred per residue: percent of window residues with score > 0.5.
iupred_dt <- fread(F_IUPRED_RESIDUES) %>% as_tibble() %>% filter(!is.na(iupred_score)) %>% as.data.table()
setkey(iupred_dt, pb_id, position)
idr_pct_in_window <- function(pb, ws, we) {
  if (is.na(pb) || is.na(ws) || is.na(we)) return(NA_real_)
  sub <- iupred_dt[pb_id == pb & position >= ws & position <= we]
  if (nrow(sub) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  100 * mean(sub$iupred_score > 0.5)
}
windows <- windows %>%
  mutate(risk_idr_junc    = pmap_dbl(list(risk_pb,    risk_ws,    risk_we),    idr_pct_in_window),
         nonrisk_idr_junc = pmap_dbl(list(nonrisk_pb, nonrisk_ws, nonrisk_we), idr_pct_in_window))
stash_window("idr_junc_pct", windows$risk_idr_junc, windows$nonrisk_idr_junc)

# NetSurfP-3 per residue: secondary structure (q3), RSA and disorder in the window.
nsp_dt <- fread(F_NETSURFP_RESIDUES) %>% as_tibble() %>%
  select(pb_id, position, rsa, q3, disorder) %>% as.data.table()
setkey(nsp_dt, pb_id, position)
nsp_window_metrics <- function(pb, ws, we) {
  empty <- list(pct_helix = NA_real_, pct_sheet = NA_real_, pct_coil = NA_real_,
                mean_rsa = NA_real_, mean_disorder = NA_real_)
  if (is.na(pb) || is.na(ws) || is.na(we)) return(empty)
  sub <- nsp_dt[pb_id == pb & position >= ws & position <= we]
  if (nrow(sub) == 0) return(empty)
  list(pct_helix = 100 * mean(sub$q3 == "H", na.rm = TRUE),
       pct_sheet = 100 * mean(sub$q3 == "E", na.rm = TRUE),
       pct_coil  = 100 * mean(sub$q3 == "C", na.rm = TRUE),
       mean_rsa  = mean(sub$rsa, na.rm = TRUE),
       mean_disorder = mean(sub$disorder, na.rm = TRUE))
}
risk_nsp    <- pmap(list(windows$risk_pb,    windows$risk_ws,    windows$risk_we),    nsp_window_metrics)
nonrisk_nsp <- pmap(list(windows$nonrisk_pb, windows$nonrisk_ws, windows$nonrisk_we), nsp_window_metrics)
for (metric in c("pct_helix", "pct_sheet", "pct_coil", "mean_rsa", "mean_disorder")) {
  stash_window(paste0("nsp_junc_", metric), map_dbl(risk_nsp, metric), map_dbl(nonrisk_nsp, metric))
}

# PTM sites in the window.
ptm_dt <- fread(F_PTM_SUMMARY) %>% as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(pb_id = str_extract(`Region ID`, "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+")) %>%
  rename(position = `PTM Position in Isoform`) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pb_id), !is.na(position)) %>%
  select(pb_id, position) %>% as.data.table()
setkey(ptm_dt, pb_id, position)
ptm_count_in_window <- function(pb, ws, we) {
  if (is.na(pb) || is.na(ws) || is.na(we)) return(NA_integer_)
  as.integer(nrow(ptm_dt[pb_id == pb & position >= ws & position <= we]))
}
windows <- windows %>%
  mutate(risk_ptm_junc    = pmap_int(list(risk_pb,    risk_ws,    risk_we),    ptm_count_in_window),
         nonrisk_ptm_junc = pmap_int(list(nonrisk_pb, nonrisk_ws, nonrisk_we), ptm_count_in_window))
stash_window("ptm_junc_count", as.numeric(windows$risk_ptm_junc), as.numeric(windows$nonrisk_ptm_junc))

# Pfam domains overlapping the window.
hmm_dt <- as.data.table(hmm_df %>% select(pb_id, seq_from, seq_to))
setkey(hmm_dt, pb_id)
pfam_count_in_window <- function(pb, ws, we) {
  if (is.na(pb) || is.na(ws) || is.na(we)) return(NA_integer_)
  sub <- hmm_dt[pb_id == pb]
  if (nrow(sub) == 0) return(0L)
  as.integer(sum(sub$seq_from <= we & sub$seq_to >= ws))
}
windows <- windows %>%
  mutate(risk_pfam_junc    = pmap_int(list(risk_pb,    risk_ws,    risk_we),    pfam_count_in_window),
         nonrisk_pfam_junc = pmap_int(list(nonrisk_pb, nonrisk_ws, nonrisk_we), pfam_count_in_window))
stash_window("pfam_junc_n_domains", as.numeric(windows$risk_pfam_junc), as.numeric(windows$nonrisk_pfam_junc))

junc_table <- windows %>%
  select(gene_name, cad_sqtl_junction, pair_type, risk_pb, nonrisk_pb,
         risk_ws, risk_we, nonrisk_ws, nonrisk_we,
         starts_with("risk_aa_"), starts_with("nonrisk_aa_"),
         risk_idr_junc, nonrisk_idr_junc, risk_ptm_junc, nonrisk_ptm_junc,
         risk_pfam_junc, nonrisk_pfam_junc)
write_csv(junc_table, res03("property_junction_region_properties.csv"))
```

# 14. Property tables

All stashed properties are assembled into one long table, split into junction-region
and whole-isoform properties, and pivoted to one row per pair with risk, nonrisk and
difference columns for every property. The AlphaFold3 metrics are added a second time
here directly from the metric files (the whole-isoform entries therefore appear both
under the `af3_iso_` prefix from section 12 and under the `af3_` prefix); the pair
and junction entries coincide and collapse to one. The two wide tables are the input
of script 06.

```{r property_tables}
seq_long <- bind_rows(unified_property_results) %>% mutate(source = "sequence_based")

af3_long_parts <- list()
for (m in af3_iso_metrics) {
  if (!m %in% names(af3_iso)) next
  iso_lookup <- af3_iso %>% select(pb_acc, !!m)
  af3_long_parts[[paste0("iso_", m)]] <- af3 %>%
    select(gene_name, junction, pair_type, risk_pb, nonrisk_pb) %>%
    dplyr::rename(cad_sqtl_junction = junction) %>%
    left_join(iso_lookup %>% dplyr::rename(risk_value    = !!m), by = c("risk_pb"    = "pb_acc")) %>%
    left_join(iso_lookup %>% dplyr::rename(nonrisk_value = !!m), by = c("nonrisk_pb" = "pb_acc")) %>%
    mutate(delta = risk_value - nonrisk_value, property = paste0("af3_", m), source = "af3_whole_isoform")
}
for (m in af3_pair_metrics) {
  if (!m %in% names(af3)) next
  af3_long_parts[[paste0("pair_", m)]] <- af3 %>%
    transmute(gene_name, cad_sqtl_junction = junction, pair_type, risk_pb, nonrisk_pb,
              risk_value = NA_real_, nonrisk_value = NA_real_, delta = .data[[m]],
              property = paste0("af3_pair_", m), source = "af3_pair_level")
}
# The gap position class is categorical and is carried as its own column.
if ("gap_position_class" %in% names(af3)) {
  af3_long_parts[["pair_gap_class"]] <- af3 %>%
    transmute(gene_name, cad_sqtl_junction = junction, pair_type, risk_pb, nonrisk_pb,
              risk_value = NA_real_, nonrisk_value = NA_real_, delta = NA_real_,
              gap_position_class = gap_position_class,
              property = "af3_pair_gap_position_class", source = "af3_pair_level_categorical")
}
for (m in af3_junc_metrics) {
  risk_col <- paste0("junc_risk_junc_", m); nonrisk_col <- paste0("junc_nonrisk_junc_", m)
  if (!risk_col %in% names(af3) || !nonrisk_col %in% names(af3)) next
  af3_long_parts[[paste0("junc_", m)]] <- af3 %>%
    transmute(gene_name, cad_sqtl_junction = junction, pair_type, risk_pb, nonrisk_pb,
              risk_value = .data[[risk_col]], nonrisk_value = .data[[nonrisk_col]],
              delta = .data[[risk_col]] - .data[[nonrisk_col]],
              property = paste0("af3_junc_", m), source = "af3_junction_region")
}
af3_long <- bind_rows(af3_long_parts)

mega_long <- bind_rows(seq_long, af3_long) %>% arrange(gene_name, pair_type, property)

JUNCTION_LEVEL_PROPS <- c(
  "af3_junc_pct_helix", "af3_junc_pct_sheet", "af3_junc_surface_charge",
```

# 15. Paired risk-versus-nonrisk statistics

Each property is compared between the risk and nonrisk members of each pair by paired
Wilcoxon signed-rank test, once on the junction-level set (strict pairs, one row per
junction) and once on the isoform-level set (one row per distinct isoform pair), with
BH correction within each level. These rows initialise Supplementary Table 15.

```{r paired_stats}
compute_stats <- function(data, value_col, level_flag_col, level_label, property_label) {
  risk_col <- paste0("risk_", value_col); nr_col <- paste0("nonrisk_", value_col)
  if (!risk_col %in% names(data) || !nr_col %in% names(data)) return(NULL)
  flags_filtered <- flags %>% filter(.data[[level_flag_col]] == TRUE) %>% distinct(gene_name, risk_pb, nonrisk_pb)
  d <- data %>%
    semi_join(flags_filtered, by = c("gene_name", "risk_pb", "nonrisk_pb")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[risk_col]]), !is.na(.data[[nr_col]]))
  if (level_flag_col == "include_in_isoform_stats") d <- d %>% distinct(gene_name, risk_pb, nonrisk_pb, .keep_all = TRUE)
  if (nrow(d) < 3) return(NULL)
  wt <- tryCatch(wilcox.test(d[[risk_col]], d[[nr_col]], paired = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
  p_val <- if (!is.null(wt)) wt$p.value else NA_real_
  tibble(property = value_col, property_label = property_label, analysis_level = level_label,
         n_pairs = nrow(d), median_risk = median(d[[risk_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
         median_nonrisk = median(d[[nr_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
         median_delta = median(d[[risk_col]] - d[[nr_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
         wilcox_statistic = if (!is.null(wt)) unname(wt$statistic) else NA_real_,
         wilcox_p = p_val, sig = sig_label(p_val))
}
```

# 16. CAD versus non-CAD, direction-matched

Risk-associated and nonrisk-associated junctions change usage in opposite directions,
so a fair background for each must share its direction of effect. One representative
isoform is chosen per junction (the risk isoform of an existing pair where one exists,
otherwise the highest-CPM isoform containing the junction), kept when the junction
lies within that isoform's CDS, and compared between CAD and non-CAD junctions
separately for junctions whose usage increases and decreases with the associated
allele, by Wilcoxon rank-sum (continuous) or Fisher's exact test (binary) with BH
correction within each level and direction.

```{r direction_matched_reps}
cad_dir_lookup <- cad_sqtls %>%
  filter(!is.na(effect_direction)) %>%
  distinct(junction_key, effect_direction) %>%
  group_by(junction_key) %>%
  mutate(n_directions = n_distinct(effect_direction)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(n_directions == 1) %>%
  distinct(junction_key, direction = effect_direction)

gen_dir_lookup <- general_sqtls %>%
  distinct(junction_key, slope) %>%
  group_by(junction_key) %>%
  summarise(slope = mean(slope), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(direction = ifelse(slope > 0, "Increased", "Decreased")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(direction)) %>%
  select(junction_key, direction)

iso_lookup_from <- function(sqtl_tbl) {
  sqtl_tbl %>%
    filter(!is.na(smc_isoforms), smc_isoforms != "") %>%
    select(junction_key, gene_name, smc_isoforms) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    mutate(pb_list = str_extract_all(smc_isoforms, "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+")) %>%
    unnest(pb_list) %>%
    distinct(junction_key, gene_name, pb_acc = pb_list)
}
cad_iso_lookup <- iso_lookup_from(cad_sqtls)
gen_iso_lookup <- iso_lookup_from(general_sqtls)

existing_reps <- flags_full %>%
  filter(pair_type %in% c("strict", "salvaged"), cad_sqtl_junction != "manual_apms") %>%
  select(junction_key = cad_sqtl_junction, rep_pb_existing = risk_pb) %>%
  distinct(junction_key, .keep_all = TRUE)
cpm_lookup <- sqanti_protein %>% select(pb_acc, CPM) %>% distinct(pb_acc, .keep_all = TRUE)

pick_cad_rep <- function(jk) {
  hit <- existing_reps %>% filter(junction_key == jk)
  if (nrow(hit) > 0) return(list(rep_pb = hit$rep_pb_existing[1], rep_source = "existing_pair"))
  pool <- cad_iso_lookup %>% filter(junction_key == jk) %>% inner_join(cpm_lookup, by = "pb_acc") %>% arrange(desc(CPM))
  if (nrow(pool) > 0) return(list(rep_pb = pool$pb_acc[1], rep_source = "highest_cpm"))
  list(rep_pb = NA_character_, rep_source = "no_isoforms")
}
pick_gen_rep <- function(jk) {
  pool <- gen_iso_lookup %>% filter(junction_key == jk) %>% inner_join(cpm_lookup, by = "pb_acc") %>% arrange(desc(CPM))
  if (nrow(pool) > 0) return(list(rep_pb = pool$pb_acc[1], rep_source = "highest_cpm"))
  list(rep_pb = NA_character_, rep_source = "no_isoforms")
}

cad_reps <- cad_dir_lookup %>%
  mutate(picks = map(junction_key, pick_cad_rep),
         rep_pb = map_chr(picks, "rep_pb"), rep_source = map_chr(picks, "rep_source")) %>%
  select(-picks) %>%
  left_join(cad_iso_lookup %>% distinct(junction_key, gene_name), by = "junction_key") %>%
  mutate(group = "CAD")
gen_reps <- gen_dir_lookup %>%
  mutate(picks = map(junction_key, pick_gen_rep),
         rep_pb = map_chr(picks, "rep_pb"), rep_source = map_chr(picks, "rep_source")) %>%
  select(-picks) %>%
  left_join(gen_iso_lookup %>% distinct(junction_key, gene_name), by = "junction_key") %>%
  mutate(group = "nonCAD")

all_reps <- bind_rows(cad_reps, gen_reps) %>%
  filter(!is.na(rep_pb)) %>%
  mutate(junction_in_cds = map2_lgl(junction_key, rep_pb, junc_in_cds))
cds_reps <- all_reps %>% filter(junction_in_cds == TRUE)
cat("Representative isoforms:", nrow(all_reps), "; junction within CDS:", nrow(cds_reps), "\n")
print(cds_reps %>% count(group))
write_csv(all_reps %>% select(-junction_in_cds), OUT_DM_REPS_ALL)
write_csv(cds_reps, OUT_DM_REPS_CDS)
```

# 17. Protein-space windows of the non-CAD junctions

The ±10-residue window of each non-CAD junction in its representative isoform is
derived from the CDS exon structure: the donor-side genomic position of the intron is
located within the CDS exons in transcription order, converted to a codon index and
expanded to the window, so that the non-CAD background can be compared with the CAD
junctions at the same protein-space resolution.

```{r noncad_aa_mapping}
noncad_reps <- cds_reps %>%
  filter(group == "nonCAD", !is.na(rep_pb)) %>%
  select(gene_name, junction_key, rep_pb)

map_junction_to_aa <- function(gene_name, junction_key, pb_acc) {
  parts <- str_split(junction_key, ":", simplify = TRUE)
  intron_start <- as.integer(parts[2]); intron_end <- as.integer(parts[3])
  out <- tibble(gene_name = gene_name, junction_key = junction_key, pb_acc = pb_acc,
                strand = NA_character_, intron_start = intron_start, intron_end = intron_end,
                status = "no_cds", mrna_junction_pos = NA_integer_, aa_junction_pos = NA_integer_,
                aa_window_start = NA_integer_, aa_window_end = NA_integer_,
                aa_window_length = NA_integer_, aa_sequence = NA_character_)
  if (!pb_acc %in% names(cds_lookup)) return(out)
  cds_gr <- cds_lookup[[pb_acc]]
  if (length(cds_gr) == 0) return(out)
  pb_strand <- as.character(strand(cds_gr)[1])
  out$strand <- pb_strand

  # CDS exons in transcription order; the donor is the last exonic base before the intron.
  cds_df <- as.data.frame(cds_gr)
  cds_df <- if (pb_strand == "+") cds_df[order(cds_df$start), ] else cds_df[order(-cds_df$start), ]
  donor_pos <- if (pb_strand == "+") intron_start - 1L else intron_end + 1L
  cds_min <- min(cds_df$start); cds_max <- max(cds_df$end)
  in_5utr <- if (pb_strand == "+") donor_pos < cds_min else donor_pos > cds_max
  in_3utr <- if (pb_strand == "+") donor_pos > cds_max else donor_pos < cds_min
  if (in_5utr) { out$status <- "junction_in_5utr"; return(out) }
  if (in_3utr) { out$status <- "junction_in_3utr"; return(out) }

  mrna_pos_cumul <- 0L; mrna_donor_pos <- NA_integer_
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(cds_df))) {
    ex_start <- cds_df$start[i]; ex_end <- cds_df$end[i]
    if (donor_pos >= ex_start && donor_pos <= ex_end) {
      mrna_donor_pos <- if (pb_strand == "+") mrna_pos_cumul + (donor_pos - ex_start + 1L)
                        else mrna_pos_cumul + (ex_end - donor_pos + 1L)
      break
    }
    mrna_pos_cumul <- mrna_pos_cumul + (ex_end - ex_start + 1L)
  }
  if (is.na(mrna_donor_pos)) { out$status <- "donor_not_in_cds"; return(out) }
  out$mrna_junction_pos <- mrna_donor_pos

  aa_pos <- ceiling(mrna_donor_pos / 3)
  out$aa_junction_pos <- as.integer(aa_pos)
  out$status <- if ((mrna_donor_pos %% 3) != 0) "ok;phase_ambiguous" else "ok"

  seq_row <- protein_lookup %>% filter(pb_acc == !!pb_acc)
  if (nrow(seq_row) == 0) { out$status <- paste0(out$status, ";no_protein_seq"); return(out) }
  prot_seq <- seq_row$protein_seq[1]; prot_len <- nchar(prot_seq)
  win_start <- max(1L, aa_pos - WINDOW_AA); win_end <- min(prot_len, aa_pos + WINDOW_AA)
  out$aa_window_start  <- as.integer(win_start)
  out$aa_window_end    <- as.integer(win_end)
  out$aa_window_length <- as.integer(win_end - win_start + 1L)
  out$aa_sequence      <- substr(prot_seq, win_start, win_end)
  out
}

aa_map_noncad <- pmap_dfr(list(noncad_reps$gene_name, noncad_reps$junction_key, noncad_reps$rep_pb),
                          map_junction_to_aa)
print(aa_map_noncad %>% count(status))
write_csv(aa_map_noncad, OUT_JUNCTION_AA_MAPPING_NONCAD)
```

# 18. CAD versus non-CAD, aggregate: whole isoform

All CAD junctions are compared with all non-CAD junctions irrespective of direction,
on the representative isoforms whose junction lies within the CDS (n = 103 and 2,672).
NMD status is a majority vote across every isoform that contains the junction, because
a single representative does not describe whether the junction usually produces an
NMD-targeted transcript.

```{r aggregate_isoform}
agg_iso <- list()

sqanti_nmd <- sqanti_protein %>%
  select(pb_acc, is_nmd) %>% filter(!is.na(is_nmd)) %>%
  distinct(pb_acc, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% mutate(is_nmd = as.logical(is_nmd))
compute_majority_nmd <- function(junction_keys) {
  smc_junc_isoform %>%
    filter(junction_key %in% junction_keys) %>%
    left_join(sqanti_nmd, by = c("pb_id" = "pb_acc")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(is_nmd)) %>%
    group_by(junction_key) %>%
    summarise(n_isoforms = n(), n_nmd = sum(is_nmd), majority_nmd = (n_nmd / n_isoforms) > 0.5, .groups = "drop")
}
nmd_majority <- bind_rows(
  compute_majority_nmd(cds_reps$junction_key[cds_reps$group == "CAD"])    %>% mutate(group = "CAD"),
  compute_majority_nmd(cds_reps$junction_key[cds_reps$group == "nonCAD"]) %>% mutate(group = "nonCAD")
) %>% mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("CAD", "nonCAD")))
agg_iso[[length(agg_iso) + 1]] <- test_binary(nmd_majority, "majority_nmd", "NMD status (majority vote)", "isoform")

d_len <- cds_reps %>% left_join(prot_seqs_full %>% select(pb_acc, aa_length), by = c("rep_pb" = "pb_acc"))
agg_iso[[length(agg_iso) + 1]] <- test_continuous(d_len, "aa_length", "Protein length", "isoform")
for (m in names(aa_labels))  agg_iso[[length(agg_iso) + 1]] <- test_continuous(d_aa,  m,  aa_labels[m],  "isoform")
for (m in names(idr_labels)) agg_iso[[length(agg_iso) + 1]] <- test_continuous(d_idr, m,  idr_labels[m], "isoform")
for (m in nsp_iso_cols)      agg_iso[[length(agg_iso) + 1]] <- test_continuous(d_nsp, m,  paste("NetSurfP3", m), "isoform")
for (lc in loc_cols)         agg_iso[[length(agg_iso) + 1]] <- test_continuous(d_dl,  lc, paste("DeepLoc", lc), "isoform")

pfam_summary <- hmm_df %>%
  group_by(pb_acc = pb_id) %>%
  summarise(n_domains = n(), n_unique_domains = n_distinct(domain_name), .groups = "drop")
d_pfam <- cds_reps %>%
  left_join(pfam_summary, by = c("rep_pb" = "pb_acc")) %>%
  mutate(n_domains = replace_na(n_domains, 0L), n_unique_domains = replace_na(n_unique_domains, 0L))
for (m in c("n_domains", "n_unique_domains")) {
  agg_iso[[length(agg_iso) + 1]] <- test_continuous(
    d_pfam, m, c(n_domains = "Pfam domain count", n_unique_domains = "Unique Pfam domains")[m], "isoform")
}

agg_iso_df <- bind_rows(agg_iso) %>% mutate(p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>% arrange(p_value)
write_csv(agg_iso_df, OUT_AGGREGATE_ISO)

master_new <- agg_iso_df %>%
  mutate(comparison = "CAD vs nonCAD (isoform, aggregate)", analysis = property_label, metric = property,
         group1 = "CAD sQTL",
         group1_value = if ("median_cad" %in% names(.)) round(median_cad, 3) else round(pct_cad, 1),
         group1_n = n_cad, group1_total = n_cad,
         group2 = "nonCAD sQTL",
         group2_value = if ("median_noncad" %in% names(.)) round(median_noncad, 3) else round(pct_noncad, 1),
         group2_n = n_noncad, group2_total = n_noncad,
         test = test, statistic = round(statistic, 2), p_value = p_value, p_adj = p_adj_bh, sig = sig)
append_master(master_new, "^CAD vs nonCAD \\(isoform, aggregate\\)$")
```

# 19. CAD versus non-CAD, aggregate: junction in genomic space

Each junction is tested for overlap with UniProt features at its exact position and
within ±30 bp (the comparison reported in Fig. 4f), for CDS overlap across all
representatives, for topological-domain subtypes and for Pfam domain categories at the
junction window; proportions are compared by Fisher's exact test with BH correction.

```{r aggregate_junction}
agg_jnc <- list()

d_cds <- all_reps %>% filter(!is.na(junction_in_cds)) %>% mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("CAD", "nonCAD")))
agg_jnc[[length(agg_jnc) + 1]] <- test_binary(d_cds, "junction_in_cds", "CDS overlap", "junction")

cds_reps_g <- cds_reps %>% mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("CAD", "nonCAD")))
junc_gr_all     <- jk_to_gr(cds_reps_g$junction_key)
junc_gr_widened <- junc_gr_all + 30L
for (annot_name in names(annotation_tracks)) {
  col_name <- paste0("overlaps_", str_replace_all(tolower(annot_name), " ", "_"))
  cds_reps_g[[col_name]] <- countOverlaps(junc_gr_all, annotation_tracks[[annot_name]], type = "any") > 0
  agg_jnc[[length(agg_jnc) + 1]] <- test_binary(cds_reps_g, col_name, annot_name, "junction")
}
for (annot_name in names(annotation_tracks)) {
  col_name <- paste0("overlaps_30bp_", str_replace_all(tolower(annot_name), " ", "_"))
  cds_reps_g[[col_name]] <- countOverlaps(junc_gr_widened, annotation_tracks[[annot_name]], type = "any") > 0
  agg_jnc[[length(agg_jnc) + 1]] <- test_binary(cds_reps_g, col_name, paste(annot_name, "(\u00b130bp)"), "junction")
}

# Topological-domain subtypes (UniProt "topological domain" names collapsed).
collapse_topo <- function(name) {
  case_when(name == "Cytoplasmic" ~ "Cytoplasmic",
            name == "Extracellular" ~ "Extracellular",
            str_detect(name, "^Lumenal") ~ "Lumenal",
            str_detect(name, "Mitochondrial") ~ "Mitochondrial",
            name == "Nuclear" | name == "Perinuclear space" ~ "Nuclear/Perinuclear",
            name == "Vesicular" | name == "Exoplasmic loop" ~ "Vesicular/Exoplasmic",
            TRUE ~ "Other")
}
topo_entries <- uniprot %>%
  filter(category == "topological domain") %>%
  mutate(topo_type = collapse_topo(name), start_1based = chromStart + 1, end_1based = chromEnd)
for (tt in unique(topo_entries$topo_type[topo_entries$topo_type != "Other"])) {
  tt_df <- topo_entries %>% filter(topo_type == tt)
  if (nrow(tt_df) < 5) next
  tt_gr <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(tt_df, seqnames.field = "chrom", start.field = "start_1based",
                                    end.field = "end_1based", keep.extra.columns = TRUE)
  seqlevelsStyle(tt_gr) <- "UCSC"
  tt_gr <- GenomicRanges::reduce(tt_gr)
  col_name <- paste0("topo_", str_replace_all(tolower(tt), "[ /]", "_"))
  cds_reps_g[[col_name]] <- countOverlaps(junc_gr_all, tt_gr, type = "any") > 0
  agg_jnc[[length(agg_jnc) + 1]] <- test_binary(cds_reps_g, col_name, paste("Topological:", tt), "junction")
}

# Pfam domain categories (keyword classes of domain name and description) at the
# junction window of the representative isoforms.
classify_domain <- function(dname, desc) {
  combined <- tolower(paste(dname, desc))
  case_when(
    str_detect(combined, "rrm|rna|rnp|helicase|dead|kh_|lsm|puf") ~ "RNA Binding/Processing",
    str_detect(combined, "kinase|phosphatase|atpase|catalytic|protease|hydrolase|transferase|synthase") ~ "Catalytic/Enzymatic",
    str_detect(combined, "wd40|tpr|ank|lrr|sh2|sh3|pdz|14-3-3|arm|heat|protein.?protein|coiled.?coil") ~ "Protein-Protein Interaction",
    str_detect(combined, "membrane|transmem|7tm|gpcr|transport|vesic|clathrin|snare") ~ "Membrane/Vesicle Traffic",
    str_detect(combined, "extracellular|integrin|cadherin|collagen|fibronectin|ecm|laminin|egf|fn3|ig_|cell.?adhes") ~ "Extracellular/Adhesion",
    str_detect(combined, "cytoskelet|actin|myosin|tubulin|tropomyosin|filamin") ~ "Cytoskeleton",
    str_detect(combined, "ubiquit|uba|ubc|proteasom|e3|sumo") ~ "Ubiquitin/Degradation",
    str_detect(combined, "lipid|pleckstrin|ph_|c1_|c2_|start|acyl|sterol") ~ "Lipid Metabolism/Binding",
    str_detect(combined, "ras|rho|rab|arf|ran|small.?gtp|gap|gef|signal") ~ "Signaling/Receptor",
    str_detect(combined, "mitochond|cox|nadh|cytochrome") ~ "Mitochondrial",
    TRUE ~ "Other")
}
hmm_domains <- hmm_df %>% mutate(unified_category = classify_domain(domain_name, description))

# Windows of the representative isoforms, CAD from script 02 and non-CAD from section 17.
window_cols <- function(df) {
  df %>% filter(str_detect(status, "^ok"), !is.na(aa_window_start)) %>%
    transmute(junction_key, pb_id = pb_acc, window_start_aa = aa_window_start, window_end_aa = aa_window_end)
}
aa_cad <- read_csv(OUT_JUNCTION_AA_MAPPING, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% window_cols() %>%
  inner_join(cds_reps %>% filter(group == "CAD") %>% select(junction_key, rep_pb),
             by = c("junction_key", "pb_id" = "rep_pb")) %>% mutate(group = "CAD")
aa_noncad <- aa_map_noncad %>% window_cols() %>%
  inner_join(cds_reps %>% filter(group == "nonCAD") %>% select(junction_key, rep_pb),
             by = c("junction_key", "pb_id" = "rep_pb")) %>% mutate(group = "nonCAD")
aa_combined <- bind_rows(aa_cad, aa_noncad)

jnc_dom <- aa_combined %>%
  inner_join(hmm_domains %>% select(pb_id, seq_from, seq_to, unified_category), by = "pb_id",
             relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  filter(window_start_aa <= seq_to & window_end_aa >= seq_from, unified_category != "Other")
cad_n_j <- n_distinct(aa_cad$junction_key)
gen_n_j <- n_distinct(aa_noncad$junction_key)
for (cat_name in unique(jnc_dom$unified_category)) {
  cad_n <- jnc_dom %>% filter(group == "CAD",    unified_category == cat_name) %>% pull(junction_key) %>% n_distinct()
  gen_n <- jnc_dom %>% filter(group == "nonCAD", unified_category == cat_name) %>% pull(junction_key) %>% n_distinct()
  if ((cad_n + gen_n) < 5) next
  ft <- tryCatch(fisher.test(matrix(c(cad_n, cad_n_j - cad_n, gen_n, gen_n_j - gen_n), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)),
                 error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(ft)) next
  agg_jnc[[length(agg_jnc) + 1]] <- tibble(
    property = paste0("domcat_", str_replace_all(tolower(cat_name), "[ /]", "_")),
    property_label = paste("Domain category:", cat_name), level = "junction",
    n_cad = cad_n_j, n_noncad = gen_n_j,
    pct_cad = round(100 * cad_n / cad_n_j, 1), pct_noncad = round(100 * gen_n / gen_n_j, 1),
    test = "Fisher's exact", statistic = round(unname(ft$estimate), 2),
    p_value = ft$p.value, sig = sig_label(ft$p.value))
}

agg_jnc_df <- bind_rows(agg_jnc) %>% mutate(p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>% arrange(p_value)
write_csv(agg_jnc_df, OUT_AGGREGATE_JUNCTION)

master_new <- agg_jnc_df %>%
  mutate(comparison = "CAD vs nonCAD (junction, aggregate)", analysis = property_label, metric = property,
         group1 = "CAD sQTL", group1_value = round(pct_cad, 1), group1_n = n_cad, group1_total = n_cad,
         group2 = "nonCAD sQTL", group2_value = round(pct_noncad, 1), group2_n = n_noncad, group2_total = n_noncad,
         test = test, statistic = round(statistic, 2), p_value = p_value, p_adj = p_adj_bh, sig = sig)
append_master(master_new, "^CAD vs nonCAD \\(junction, aggregate\\)$")
cat("Fig. 4f source rows (\u00b130 bp):\n")
print(agg_jnc_df %>% filter(str_detect(property, "^overlaps_30bp")) %>%
        select(property_label, n_cad, n_noncad, pct_cad, pct_noncad, p_value))
```

# 20. CAD versus non-CAD, aggregate: junction window (±10 residues)

```{r aggregate_window}
aa_cad_full <- read_csv(OUT_JUNCTION_AA_MAPPING, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(str_detect(status, "^ok"), !is.na(aa_window_start)) %>%
  inner_join(cds_reps %>% filter(group == "CAD") %>% select(junction_key, rep_pb),
             by = c("junction_key", "pb_acc" = "rep_pb")) %>% mutate(group = "CAD")
aa_noncad_full <- aa_map_noncad %>%
  filter(str_detect(status, "^ok"), !is.na(aa_window_start)) %>%
  inner_join(cds_reps %>% filter(group == "nonCAD") %>% select(junction_key, rep_pb),
             by = c("junction_key", "pb_acc" = "rep_pb")) %>% mutate(group = "nonCAD")
aa_all <- bind_rows(aa_cad_full, aa_noncad_full) %>% mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("CAD", "nonCAD")))
cat("Windowed junctions: CAD", sum(aa_all$group == "CAD"), "; non-CAD", sum(aa_all$group == "nonCAD"), "\n")

agg_win <- list()

aa_all <- aa_all %>%
  mutate(win_hydropathy  = map_dbl(aa_sequence, ~ aa_mean_for_seq(.x, aa_vecs$hydropathy)),
         win_polarity    = map_dbl(aa_sequence, ~ aa_mean_for_seq(.x, aa_vecs$polarity)),
         win_volume      = map_dbl(aa_sequence, ~ aa_mean_for_seq(.x, aa_vecs$volume)),
         win_flexibility = map_dbl(aa_sequence, ~ aa_mean_for_seq(.x, aa_vecs$flexibility)))
win_aa_labels <- c(win_hydropathy = "Junction window: hydropathy", win_polarity = "Junction window: polarity",
                   win_volume = "Junction window: volume", win_flexibility = "Junction window: flexibility")
for (m in names(win_aa_labels)) agg_win[[length(agg_win) + 1]] <- test_continuous(aa_all, m, win_aa_labels[m], "junction_aa10")

# IUPred per window (the per-residue table is keyed by pb_id only here).
iupred_res <- fread(F_IUPRED_RESIDUES)
setkey(iupred_res, pb_id)
compute_window_idr <- function(pb, ws, we) {
  if (is.na(pb) || is.na(ws) || is.na(we)) return(c(NA_real_, NA_real_))
  sub <- iupred_res[pb_id == pb & position >= ws & position <= we]
  if (nrow(sub) == 0) return(c(NA_real_, NA_real_))
  c(100 * mean(sub$iupred_score > 0.5, na.rm = TRUE), mean(sub$iupred_score, na.rm = TRUE))
}
idr_results <- pmap_dfr(list(aa_all$pb_acc, aa_all$aa_window_start, aa_all$aa_window_end),
                        function(pb, ws, we) { v <- compute_window_idr(pb, ws, we); tibble(win_idr_pct = v[1], win_disorder = v[2]) })
aa_all <- bind_cols(aa_all, idr_results)
for (m in c("win_idr_pct", "win_disorder")) {
  agg_win[[length(agg_win) + 1]] <- test_continuous(
    aa_all, m, c(win_idr_pct = "Junction window: IDR %", win_disorder = "Junction window: disorder score")[m], "junction_aa10")
}

# NetSurfP-3 per window.
nsp_res <- fread(F_NETSURFP_RESIDUES)
setkey(nsp_res, pb_id)
compute_window_nsp <- function(pb, ws, we) {
  empty <- tibble(win_nsp_helix = NA_real_, win_nsp_sheet = NA_real_, win_nsp_coil = NA_real_,
                  win_nsp_rsa = NA_real_, win_nsp_disorder = NA_real_)
  if (is.na(pb) || is.na(ws) || is.na(we)) return(empty)
  sub <- nsp_res[pb_id == pb & position >= ws & position <= we]
  if (nrow(sub) == 0) return(empty)
  tibble(win_nsp_helix = 100 * mean(sub$q3 == "H", na.rm = TRUE),
         win_nsp_sheet = 100 * mean(sub$q3 == "E", na.rm = TRUE),
         win_nsp_coil  = 100 * mean(sub$q3 == "C", na.rm = TRUE),
         win_nsp_rsa   = mean(sub$rsa, na.rm = TRUE),
         win_nsp_disorder = 100 * mean(sub$disorder, na.rm = TRUE))
}
aa_all <- bind_cols(aa_all, pmap_dfr(list(aa_all$pb_acc, aa_all$aa_window_start, aa_all$aa_window_end), compute_window_nsp))
win_nsp_labels <- c(win_nsp_helix = "Junction window: NSP % helix", win_nsp_sheet = "Junction window: NSP % sheet",
                    win_nsp_coil = "Junction window: NSP % coil", win_nsp_rsa = "Junction window: NSP RSA",
                    win_nsp_disorder = "Junction window: NSP disorder")
for (m in names(win_nsp_labels)) agg_win[[length(agg_win) + 1]] <- test_continuous(aa_all, m, win_nsp_labels[m], "junction_aa10")

# PTM sites per window.
ptm_data <- read_tsv(F_PTM_SUMMARY, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(pb_extract = str_extract(`Region ID`, "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+"), ptm_pos = `PTM Position in Isoform`) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pb_extract), !is.na(ptm_pos))
setDT(ptm_data); setkey(ptm_data, pb_extract)
compute_window_ptm <- function(pb, ws, we) {
  if (is.na(pb) || is.na(ws) || is.na(we)) return(0L)
  sub <- ptm_data[pb_extract == pb]
  if (nrow(sub) == 0) return(0L)
  sum(sub$ptm_pos >= ws & sub$ptm_pos <= we, na.rm = TRUE)
}
aa_all$win_ptm_count <- pmap_int(list(aa_all$pb_acc, aa_all$aa_window_start, aa_all$aa_window_end),
                                 function(pb, ws, we) as.integer(compute_window_ptm(pb, ws, we)))
agg_win[[length(agg_win) + 1]] <- test_continuous(aa_all, "win_ptm_count", "Junction window: PTM count", "junction_aa10")

# Pfam domains per window.
hmm_win_dt <- as.data.table(hmm_df %>% select(pb_id, seq_from, seq_to))
compute_window_pfam <- function(pb, ws, we) {
  sum(hmm_win_dt[pb_id == pb, seq_from] <= we & hmm_win_dt[pb_id == pb, seq_to] >= ws, na.rm = TRUE)
}
aa_all$win_pfam_count <- pmap_int(list(aa_all$pb_acc, aa_all$aa_window_start, aa_all$aa_window_end),
                                  function(pb, ws, we) {
                                    if (is.na(pb) || is.na(ws) || is.na(we)) return(0L)
                                    as.integer(compute_window_pfam(pb, ws, we))
                                  })
agg_win[[length(agg_win) + 1]] <- test_continuous(aa_all, "win_pfam_count", "Junction window: Pfam count", "junction_aa10")

write_csv(aa_all, OUT_AA10_TABLE)
agg_win_df <- bind_rows(agg_win) %>% mutate(p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>% arrange(p_value)
write_csv(agg_win_df, OUT_AGGREGATE_AA10)

master_new <- agg_win_df %>%
  mutate(comparison = "CAD vs nonCAD (junction_aa10, aggregate)", analysis = property_label, metric = property,
         group1 = "CAD sQTL", group1_value = round(median_cad, 3), group1_n = n_cad, group1_total = n_cad,
         group2 = "nonCAD sQTL", group2_value = round(median_noncad, 3), group2_n = n_noncad, group2_total = n_noncad,
         test = test, statistic = round(statistic, 2), p_value = p_value, p_adj = p_adj_bh, sig = sig)
append_master(master_new, "^CAD vs nonCAD \\(junction_aa10, aggregate\\)$")
```

# 21. CAD versus non-CAD, sub-property classes

The categorical components of the PTM and localization predictions are tested as
binary presence/absence: each PTM class with at least 50 sites in the proteome, on the
whole representative isoform and within the junction window; and DeepLoc compartment
assignments, multi-compartment calls and membrane types on the whole isoform.

```{r aggregate_subproperties}
agg_sub <- list()

ptm_class_data <- read_tsv(F_PTM_SUMMARY, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(pb_acc = str_extract(`Region ID`, "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+"),
         ptm_pos = `PTM Position in Isoform`, mod_class = `Modification Class`) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pb_acc), !is.na(ptm_pos), !is.na(mod_class))
top_ptm_classes <- ptm_class_data %>% count(mod_class) %>% filter(n >= 50) %>% pull(mod_class)

for (ptm_class in top_ptm_classes) {
  pbs_with_class <- ptm_class_data %>% filter(mod_class == ptm_class) %>% pull(pb_acc) %>% unique()
  d <- cds_reps_g %>% mutate(has_class_ptm = rep_pb %in% pbs_with_class)
  r <- test_binary(d, "has_class_ptm", paste("Whole-isoform has", ptm_class), "isoform")
  if (!is.null(r)) {
    r$property <- paste0("ptm_iso_has_", str_replace_all(tolower(ptm_class), "[ /-]", "_"))
    agg_sub[[length(agg_sub) + 1]] <- r
  }
}

setDT(ptm_class_data); setkey(ptm_class_data, pb_acc)
for (ptm_class in top_ptm_classes) {
  ptm_sub <- ptm_class_data[mod_class == ptm_class]
  has_class_in_window <- function(pb, ws, we) {
    if (is.na(pb) || is.na(ws) || is.na(we)) return(NA)
    sub <- ptm_sub[pb_acc == pb]
    if (nrow(sub) == 0) return(FALSE)
    any(sub$ptm_pos >= ws & sub$ptm_pos <= we, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  aa_with_flag <- aa_all %>%
    mutate(has_class_ptm_window = pmap_lgl(list(pb_acc, aa_window_start, aa_window_end), has_class_in_window))
  r <- test_binary(aa_with_flag, "has_class_ptm_window", paste("Junction window has", ptm_class), "junction_aa10")
  if (!is.null(r)) {
    r$property <- paste0("ptm_win_has_", str_replace_all(tolower(ptm_class), "[ /-]", "_"))
    agg_sub[[length(agg_sub) + 1]] <- r
  }
}

loc_components <- c("Cytoplasm", "Nucleus", "Extracellular", "Cell membrane", "Mitochondrion",
                    "Endoplasmic reticulum", "Golgi apparatus", "Lysosome/Vacuole", "Peroxisome")
d_loc <- cds_reps_g %>% left_join(dl_smc %>% select(pb_id, Localizations), by = c("rep_pb" = "pb_id"))
for (lc in loc_components) {
  col_name <- paste0("loc_assigned_", str_replace_all(tolower(lc), "[ /]", "_"))
  d_loc[[col_name]] <- str_detect(replace_na(d_loc$Localizations, ""), fixed(lc))
  agg_sub[[length(agg_sub) + 1]] <- test_binary(d_loc, col_name, paste("DeepLoc assigned:", lc), "isoform")
}
d_loc$is_multi_compartment <- str_count(replace_na(d_loc$Localizations, ""), "\\|") > 0
agg_sub[[length(agg_sub) + 1]] <- test_binary(d_loc, "is_multi_compartment", "DeepLoc: multi-compartment", "isoform")

if ("Membrane types" %in% names(dl_smc)) {
  d_mem <- cds_reps_g %>% left_join(dl_smc %>% select(pb_id, `Membrane types`), by = c("rep_pb" = "pb_id"))
  for (mt in c("Soluble", "Peripheral", "Transmembrane", "Lipid anchor")) {
    col_name <- paste0("mem_", str_replace_all(tolower(mt), "[ /]", "_"))
    d_mem[[col_name]] <- str_detect(replace_na(d_mem[["Membrane types"]], ""), fixed(mt))
    agg_sub[[length(agg_sub) + 1]] <- test_binary(d_mem, col_name, paste("DeepLoc membrane:", mt), "isoform")
  }
}

agg_sub_df <- bind_rows(agg_sub) %>%
  group_by(level) %>% mutate(p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>% ungroup() %>%
  arrange(p_value)
write_csv(agg_sub_df, OUT_AGGREGATE_SUB)

master_new <- agg_sub_df %>%
  mutate(comparison = sprintf("CAD vs nonCAD (%s, subprop)", level), analysis = property_label, metric = property,
         group1 = "CAD sQTL", group1_value = round(pct_cad, 1), group1_n = n_cad, group1_total = n_cad,
         group2 = "nonCAD sQTL", group2_value = round(pct_noncad, 1), group2_n = n_noncad, group2_total = n_noncad,
         test = test, statistic = round(statistic, 2), p_value = p_value, p_adj = p_adj_bh, sig = sig)
append_master(master_new, "CAD vs nonCAD \\(.*, subprop\\)")

master <- read_csv(OUT_PROPERTY_STATS_MASTER, show_col_types = FALSE)
cat("Supplementary Table 15:", nrow(master), "rows in", n_distinct(master$comparison), "comparison classes\n")
print(master %>% count(comparison))
stopifnot("expected 11 comparison classes" = n_distinct(master$comparison) == 11)
```

# 22. Predicted NMD status per junction

For every CAD and non-CAD junction, the fraction of long-read isoforms containing it
that are flagged NMD by SQANTI Protein is summarised as a majority vote; these tables
are compared and plotted in script 10 (Extended Data Fig. 5b) and annotate
Supplementary Table 13.

```{r nmd_majority_vote}
sqanti_nmd_all <- sqanti_protein %>% select(pb_acc, is_nmd) %>% distinct()
majority_vote <- function(keys) {
  smc_junc_isoform %>%
    filter(junction_key %in% keys) %>%
    left_join(sqanti_nmd_all, by = c("pb_id" = "pb_acc")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(is_nmd)) %>%
    group_by(junction_key) %>%
    summarise(n_isoforms = n(), n_nmd = sum(is_nmd == TRUE), majority_nmd = n_nmd / n_isoforms > 0.5, .groups = "drop")
}
cad_jnc_nmd    <- majority_vote(cad_junction_keys_all)
noncad_jnc_nmd <- majority_vote(setdiff(general_junction_keys_all, cad_junction_keys_all))
cat("CAD junctions with NMD majority:", sum(cad_jnc_nmd$majority_nmd), "of", nrow(cad_jnc_nmd),
    "; non-CAD:", sum(noncad_jnc_nmd$majority_nmd), "of", nrow(noncad_jnc_nmd), "\n")
write_csv(cad_jnc_nmd,    OUT_NMD_CAD_MAJORITY)
write_csv(noncad_jnc_nmd, OUT_NMD_NONCAD_MAJORITY)
```

# 23. Named domain changes within pairs

Pfam domain content is compared by name between the members of each of the 94
computed pairs, over the whole protein and within ±10 residues of the junction, to
list which domains the risk isoform gains or loses; this is the basis of the Results
statement that domain content differed within 43 of 94 pairs.

```{r domain_changes}
pairs_sqtl <- flags_full %>%
  filter(include_in_isoform_stats, pair_type != "manual_apms") %>%
  distinct(gene_name, risk_pb, nonrisk_pb, .keep_all = TRUE)
stopifnot("expected 94 computed pairs" = nrow(pairs_sqtl) == 94)

dom_by_iso <- hmm_df %>%
  distinct(pb_id, domain_acc_clean, domain_name) %>%
  group_by(pb_id) %>%
  summarise(doms = list(setNames(domain_name, domain_acc_clean)), .groups = "drop")

domain_changes <- pairs_sqtl %>%
  select(gene_name, cad_sqtl_junction, pair_type, risk_pb, nonrisk_pb) %>%
  left_join(dom_by_iso %>% rename(risk_doms = doms),    by = c("risk_pb" = "pb_id")) %>%
  left_join(dom_by_iso %>% rename(nonrisk_doms = doms), by = c("nonrisk_pb" = "pb_id")) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(risk_doms    = list(if (is.null(risk_doms))    character(0) else risk_doms),
         nonrisk_doms = list(if (is.null(nonrisk_doms)) character(0) else nonrisk_doms),
         lost_in_risk   = paste(sort(unique(setdiff(nonrisk_doms, risk_doms))), collapse = "; "),
         gained_in_risk = paste(sort(unique(setdiff(risk_doms, nonrisk_doms))), collapse = "; "),
         shared_doms    = paste(sort(unique(intersect(risk_doms, nonrisk_doms))), collapse = "; "),
         n_lost   = length(setdiff(nonrisk_doms, risk_doms)),
         n_gained = length(setdiff(risk_doms, nonrisk_doms)),
         change = case_when(n_gained > 0 & n_lost > 0 ~ "Both gain and loss",
                            n_gained > 0 ~ "Risk gains domain",
                            n_lost   > 0 ~ "Risk loses domain",
                            TRUE ~ "Same domain content")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-risk_doms, -nonrisk_doms) %>%
  distinct(gene_name, risk_pb, nonrisk_pb, .keep_all = TRUE)

print(count(domain_changes, change) %>% mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)))
write_csv(domain_changes, OUT_DOMAIN_CHANGES_NAMED)

# Domains within WINDOW_AA residues of the junction in each isoform.
jaa_ok <- read_csv(OUT_JUNCTION_AA_MAPPING, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% filter(str_starts(status, "ok"))
doms_near <- function(pb, aa) {
  if (is.na(pb) || is.na(aa)) return(character(0))
  d <- hmm_df %>% filter(pb_id == pb, seq_from <= aa + WINDOW_AA, seq_to >= aa - WINDOW_AA)
  unique(d$domain_name)
}
domain_changes_local <- pairs_sqtl %>%
  select(gene_name, cad_sqtl_junction, risk_pb, nonrisk_pb) %>%
  left_join(jaa_ok %>% select(junction_key, pb_acc, aa_junction_pos),
            by = c("cad_sqtl_junction" = "junction_key", "risk_pb" = "pb_acc")) %>%
  rename(aa_risk = aa_junction_pos) %>%
  left_join(jaa_ok %>% select(junction_key, pb_acc, aa_junction_pos),
            by = c("cad_sqtl_junction" = "junction_key", "nonrisk_pb" = "pb_acc")) %>%
  rename(aa_nonrisk = aa_junction_pos) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(risk_local    = list(doms_near(risk_pb,    aa_risk)),
         nonrisk_local = list(doms_near(nonrisk_pb, aa_nonrisk)),
         lost_at_junction   = paste(sort(setdiff(nonrisk_local, risk_local)), collapse = "; "),
         gained_at_junction = paste(sort(setdiff(risk_local, nonrisk_local)), collapse = "; "),
         shared_at_junction = paste(sort(intersect(risk_local, nonrisk_local)), collapse = "; "),
         change_local = case_when(
           is.na(aa_risk) & is.na(aa_nonrisk) ~ "Not mappable",
           lost_at_junction != "" & gained_at_junction != "" ~ "Both gain and loss",
           gained_at_junction != "" ~ "Risk gains domain",
           lost_at_junction != "" ~ "Risk loses domain",
           length(risk_local) + length(nonrisk_local) == 0 ~ "No domain at junction",
           TRUE ~ "Same domain at junction")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-risk_local, -nonrisk_local)

print(count(domain_changes_local, change_local) %>% mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)))
write_csv(domain_changes_local, OUT_DOMAIN_CHANGES_LOCAL)
```
